_comment: LandfallElementals (lfe-fury, 2026-10-18): the SAME lethal as lfe_soulstoke_put_fury_lethal, with NO
lands -- Smokebraider is the only mana source. Its two mana may be spent only on Elemental spells or
ABILITIES OF ELEMENTALS; Incandescent Soulstoke is an Elemental, so Smokebraider alone pays the {1}{R}
put. Guards the restricted payer's ability half end to end (the enumerator must price the put against
the creature-only source, and the real executor must pay it under the ability-source scope): a
regression here leaves Fury in hand and the opponent alive.
